description.zh: 上游 bundui 的真实组件 pricing-sections-01 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染。
description.en: Showcase your product or service plans with elegantly designed Tailwind CSS pricing sections. These layouts highlight features, pricing tiers, and value propositions with clarity, helping users make informed decisions. Ideal for SaaS platforms, subscription services, or product pages aiming for a modern, transparent, and conversion-friendly presentation. Rendered from the original source at commit c07468613dfe7db776f1749a0921a1e5e7bd33d5.
